svg.text: LLD 3 — Photo pipeline: bytes never pass through the API
Hot 30 d → Cool → Cold 90 d → Archive 365 d

Steps 1 to 5 are in the templates; the queue consumer (6, 7) and the nightly sweep are planned. The API carries only small feedback and support JPEGs (at most 300 KB). Phone budget: photos at most 3 MB a day.
